_doc: A folded grey blanket (#819; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/doctor/): wool blankets folded in three and laid flat, 48 x 37 cm, the folds' bights to +x, the wards' issue of the 1860s-80s (grey with a dark band at each end; white with blue bands; brown). A blanket a member (wood `canvas`): it burns, and the pile comes down with what it lies on. A member drawn soft, not cloth (ClothProp): nobody unfolds one yet. Baked the gun way (tools/blender/props/doctor_d3.py). Written by tools/props/doctor.py.
